generated_step: Step 12/21: Report standards and triage (G6.1-6.3, C15)

dossier.description: Specialized domain research monograph examining a specific thesis, sub-cycle, or empirical phenomenon.

dimensions.question: Must formulate a single, explicit, falsifiable analytical research question or problem statement in the introduction.
dimensions.scope: Must bound temporal range, geographic coverage, institutional domains, and relevant market or system parameters.
dimensions.summary: Must include a standalone Executive Summary / Abstract synthesizing the core thesis, primary findings, and key takeaways in <=250 words.
dimensions.method: Must define the investigative or modeling methodology (e.g. historical comparative analysis, econometric time-series, dynamical systems formalization, or critical literature synthesis).
dimensions.evidence: Must ground claims in primary empirical time series, official institutional datasets (e.g. CBO, IMF, WGC, FRED), or peer-reviewed literature, distinguishing measured facts from theoretical inferences.
dimensions.competing views: Must dedicate a substantive section to rival hypotheses, academic counterarguments, and explicit falsification thresholds.
dimensions.limitations: Must explicitly document measurement error, benchmark saturation, data gaps, sample selection bias, and epistemic uncertainty bounds.
dimensions.proportional conclusions: Must calibrate conclusions strictly to the weight of evidence, rejecting hyperbolic determinism, inevitable collapse narratives, or unhedged forecasting.
dimensions.references: Must provide complete, verifiable academic and institutional citations with standard metadata (authors, title, publication/source, year, URL/DOI where available).

expert_review.description: Independent domain expert critique and benchmark evaluation of a core pillar.

dimensions.question: Must evaluate whether the domain's dossiers satisfy publication-grade intellectual rigor, source fidelity, and empirical validity.
dimensions.scope: Covers 100% of the active dossiers within the designated foundational pillar.
dimensions.summary: Must provide an executive scorecard grading empirical grounding, conceptual coherence, and structural integrity.
dimensions.method: Must apply standardized peer-review audit rubrics, cross-checking claims against external primary literature.
dimensions.evidence: Must cite specific dossier sections, primary source discrepancies, and concrete historical or econometric counter-examples.
dimensions.competing views: Must synthesize major external academic critiques (e.g., Wilentz, Fischer, Solow, Gordon, Acemoglu) challenging the pillar's core theories.
dimensions.limitations: Must acknowledge the limits of domain-specific heuristics and the risk of retrospective overfitting.
dimensions.proportional conclusions: Must differentiate between robust empirical foundations and speculative narratives.
dimensions.references: Must include authoritative external domain bibliographies and primary data repositories.

overview.description: Pillar-level synthesized introduction establishing structural architecture, taxonomy, and roadmap.

dimensions.question: Must articulate how the foundational framework operates, its historical origins, and its systemic role within the broader Convergence thesis.
dimensions.scope: Comprehensive structural mapping of the entire pillar across its theoretical, empirical, and applied dimensions.
dimensions.summary: Must provide a synthesized orientation outlining directory architecture, core models, and primary investigative milestones.
dimensions.method: Taxonomic classification and conceptual framework modeling.
dimensions.evidence: Synthesizes foundational primary texts and landmark empirical validations across the pillar.
dimensions.competing views: Summarizes the foundational debates and epistemological controversies surrounding the framework.
dimensions.limitations: Outlines theoretical boundary conditions where the framework loses predictive power.
dimensions.proportional conclusions: Frames the pillar as an analytical lens or heuristic rather than a deterministic law of history.
dimensions.references: Comprehensive foundational bibliography linking key literature across all pillar dossiers.

synthesis.description: Master cross-pillar integrative capstone monograph reconciling and coupling all 5 foundational frameworks.

dimensions.question: Must investigate whether and through what precise mechanisms the 5 independent multi-cycle frameworks couple, amplify, or dampen one another between 2024 and 2035.
dimensions.scope: Pan-disciplinary cross-cycle synthesis spanning macroeconomics, geopolitics, demography, technology, and intelligence takeoff.
dimensions.summary: Comprehensive multi-level executive synthesis articulating synchronous vs asynchronous risk pathways.
dimensions.method: Coupled non-linear dynamical systems modeling, multi-domain risk matrixing, and cross-impact balance analysis.
dimensions.evidence: Harmonized empirical data integrating verified time series from all 5 pillars.
dimensions.competing views: Thorough red-teaming of synchronous convergence fatalism, evaluating asynchronous desynchronization and negative feedback loops.
dimensions.limitations: Explicitly addresses compounding forecasting error, high-dimensional uncertainty, and model fragility.
dimensions.proportional conclusions: Replaces deterministic crisis certainty with probabilistic, condition-dependent scenario distributions.
dimensions.references: Master cross-disciplinary citation register linking authoritative primary literature across all domains.

readme.description: Structural directory navigation and folder orientation document.

dimensions.question: Must clearly define the contents, organization, and navigational roadmap of the directory.
dimensions.scope: Strictly limited to the subfolder or directory it documents.
dimensions.summary: Brief directory overview explaining the purpose of contained files.
dimensions.evidence: Direct links and accurate path references to active dossiers.
dimensions.competing views: Not applicable; notes organizational alternatives or deprecated structures where relevant.
dimensions.limitations: Notes active development status and pending dossier enhancements.
dimensions.proportional conclusions: Objective descriptions of repository assets without analytical overreach.
dimensions.references: Internal hyperlinks resolving to repository resources.
